- Title: Pokemon Trading Card Prices
- Group Members: Ethan De Brauw, Linnea Joanen, Eli Stottrup
- Short Description: Cost-benefit analysis of Pokemon card market
- Research Questions: How do markets change over time? What impact do PSA grades have on the card (are some cards worth more ungraded, given that PSA grading is ~$80/card and takes ~6 months to complete)? Are the markets too volatile to make large investments?
- Reasons for research: People are becoming increasingly dependent on 'side hustles,' especially those surrounding pop culture (sports gambling, labubus, baseball cards) and the Pokemon market is particularly lucrative and in high demand. 
- Communication method: We will mostly use Google Chat.
